Bedding supplies and some practical advice
The desk is glad to help before departure

Travelers should review animal travel arrangements before arriving at the airport.

Aurelia Skyways asks every traveler to make sure the carrier is secure, the bedding is clean, and the animal is settled in a way that supports calm movement through the journey. Please keep travel documents close at hand and allow the desk to check the details in advance, since careful preparation helps boarding proceed smoothly. <<FACT F060>> The Companion Animal Travel Desk can also advise on carrier fit, handling, and the usual checks that support the welfare of the animal.

If you are traveling with a pet for the first time, please remain near the desk until the review is complete. Clear labeling and sensible packing both help our staff assist you without delay. We aim to make the process orderly and reassuring for all travelers.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
